Ravi (Sales): Quick heads-up: RegulatedBank wants a 30-day POC. Must ensure inference and derived artifacts never leave EU datacenters. They will supply an Azure Key Vault CMK. Need routing policy, subprocessor list, and a rough POC cost.

Leah (Solutions): Clarify: control-plane telemetry in US is acceptable? Also do they require no cross-cloud backups at all?

Ravi (Sales): Control plane OK. No backups or snapshots outside EU during POC. Failover should be automated to a secondary EU region with minimal data loss.

Ibrahim (Platform): Short feasibility: Yes for tenant-region pin + warm standby. Requirements:
- All data plane services (compute, cache, object storage) must be EU-only.
- KV replication will be eventual; on failover expect small token loss window.

Ibrahim (Platform): Minimal routing policy for their audit:
```json
{"tenant":"regulatedbank","primary":"westeurope","secondary":"northeurope","data_plane":"eu-only","subprocessors":["azure-westeurope","azure-northeurope"]}
```

Claire (Legal): We'll provide a subprocessor addendum listing EU subprocessors. RegulatedBank also asked for evidence that payloads stayed in EU  we can provide egress IP ranges, traceroute snapshots during POC, and signed attestation for the POC period.

KMS Bot: KV reachability check: azure-key-vault (westeurope) -> reachable from eu-worker-subnet: PASS. Requires service principal + firewall rules.

Leah (Solutions): Pricing sketch: Hosted Dedicated POC (1 month) = reserved capacity + EU premium. Regional pin add-on fee + warm-standby overhead (~20% capacity). Private deployment available but ~4x onboarding and longer lead time. Exact numbers need qps and model size.

Ravi (Sales): I'll collect QPS, tokens per request, and model details today. Owners: Ibrahim = routing policy + tech note; Leah = pricing + SOW; Claire = subprocessor addendum.

Ibrahim (Platform): Also recommending we offer Private in parallel if they need absolute network path guarantees. I'll prepare IP list & peering checklist once we have KV resource IDs.

Ravi (Sales): Great, looping in @RegulatedBank-ps. Will follow up with the metrics. :thumbsup:

-- end of thread --
